titles.title: Calla

description: A white, teardrop-shaped calla lily fills the frame. A bright yellow spike protrudes from its center. At the top of the work, a textured, gray background resembles a crumpled piece of paper, while at the bottom, the background is a smooth turquoise green color.
title: Calla
